summary: NovaCare: quota enforcement + client retry amplification causing apparent inference timeouts
description: Issue summary: NovaCare reported intermittent inference requests that either time out or return very slow responses starting 2026-03-10 09:15 UTC. Initial customer observation suggested a latency regression in the serving stack. Impact: production traffic for NovaCare's chat endpoint experiences degraded throughput and increased user-perceived timeouts leading to support tickets and rollbacks in their client. Environment: NovaCare is on a Dedicated cluster in us-east using model gpt-like-2.7b-quant with client-side retries implemented in their SDK.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Issue observed at 2026-03-10 09:15 UTC during peak window for NovaCare (daily digest).
2) Customer client issues 20 concurrent streaming generate calls with their normal retry policy (immediate retry + up to 3 attempts, no jitter),
3) Several calls receive 429/QuotaExceeded responses from our gateway; customer SDK treats these as failures and retries immediately,
4) Retries rapidly increase request rate, causing rate-limiter to apply broader per-tenant throttling,
5) Result: many requests either hang until timeout on client side or return delayed responses once the token-bucket recovers.
logs: 2026-03-10T09:15:21Z gateway ERROR tenant=novacare code=429 quota=burst_limit remaining=0
comments: 2026-03-10 Diego Morales: Assigned. Noted that customer is on dedicated pool. Initial hypothesis: client retry policy amplifying quota enforcement leading to transient token starvation.
2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Customer provided trace snippets and SDK version 1.2.3. They confirm they treat 429 the same as any network failure and immediately retry.

2026-03-11 SRE (Liu Chen): Correlated with our per-tenant token-bucket logs. Spike in retry_rate coincides with token_bucket depletion. See dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/tenant-rate/novacare?from=2026-03-10T09:00Z&to=2026-03-10T10:00Z
2026-03-11 Product (Maya Singh): Recommend quick mitigation: send Retry-After on 429 and add response header indicating quota type (burst vs sustained).
investigation_notes: Observed pattern: initial set of requests legitimately exceeded configured burst quota; gateway returned 429s with no Retry-After header in some code paths (legacy rate-limiter behavior).
Customer SDK (v1.2.3) treats all non-2xx as candidate for immediate retry; no exponential backoff and no parsing of Retry-After. This produced a retry amplification factor ~4x during peak window.

Token-bucket algorithm: burst tokens drained in <3s under amplified load; refill_rate insufficient to service immediate back-to-back retries. The serving runtime queued some requests which increased tail latency (observed 95th percentile jump from 180ms to 1.2s).
No model-side performance regression was detected when isolating single requests; CPU/GPU metrics remained within expected baselines for the model. Latency-only when request burst persisted.
resolution: - Gate change: gateway now returns Retry-After header for quota 429s (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2471) to encourage client backoff.
- Emergency throttling rule tuned to add randomized jitter on server-side retries to reduce sawtooth load.
- Update SDK to >=1.2.5 which treats 429 as rate-limited and implements exponential backoff with full jitter. Link to patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rdw-sdk/releases/tag/v1.2.5
- Short-term capacity option: increase dedicated burst quota for NovaCare for the daily digest window while they roll out SDK changes.
- Add automatic Retry-After generation for all quota enforcement paths and ensure header includes recommended backoff values (OWNER: infra/rate-limiter).
- Add per-tenant adaptive throttling that considers retry amplification signals and temporarily reduces per-IP retry acceptance (OWNER: serving/runtime).
- Improve observability: add retry_ratio and effective_throttle_ratio panels to per-tenant dashboard (OWNER: console).
Status: Customer observed restored latency after SDK update + temporary quota increase. Monitoring for recurrence; ticket will be closed after 48h of stable metrics.
